jobs.title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

jobs.title: Hydro Cash Flow Planning & Analysis Analyst
jobs.jd: Job Description Summary Are you ready to drive global impact and solve complex financial challenges? As part of the Hydro Finance team at GE Vernova, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing Hydro’s Free Cash Flow (FCF) and working capital generation. You will serve as the primary finance lead for cash performance, bridging the gap between operational regional activities and high-level strategic planning. You will be responsible for the end-to-end rhythm of cash reporting—from weekly project-level data consolidation to annual long-range strategy—ensuring that the Hydro CFO and CEO have the analytical clarity required to drive the business. What impact you’ll make: You will lead the Hydro cash planning function, managing the full spectrum of cash-inflows and outflows. Your impact spans from detailed weekly operational reporting to annual budgeting and strategy cycles. You will act as a consultant to the Hydro Leadership Team (HLT), providing the insights necessary to translate operational regional activity into consolidated financial performance. Job Description Essential Responsibilities : Lead the annual Budget and Strategy cycles (May–October). This includes managing regional "bottoms-up" inputs, coordinating with Commercial and functional leads on indirect impacts (Capex, Restructuring, PPA), and facilitating the final reviews with the Hydro CFO/CEO. Lead the Quarterly Management Indicator (QMI) and Monthly Operating Review (MOR) rhythms. Consolidate regional R&Os (Risks & Opportunities), prepare presentations for the HLT, and define the handicap cases that shape the business forecast. Drive the quarterly closing rhythm (LCD to LCD+8). This includes daily HFM data analysis, reconciling Direct-to-Indirect figures, managing intercompany (DT-DF) transactions, and ensuring accuracy in VPLAN and Workiva submissions. Oversee the integrity of the weekly FCF bowler, past-due tracking, and billing/collection dashboards. You are accountable for the accuracy of regional inputs and the standardization of reporting tools (Smartsheet, Masterfiles, and VRPTG/Cloud Cash Flow). Act as the primary financial partner to Regional CFOs and Project Directors. Influence regional teams to maintain data discipline and drive cash linearity. Required Qualification: Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in finance, accounting or related field; Relevant experience in Financial Reporting and Analysis; Advanced English knowledge Desired Characteristics Deep understanding of financial reporting systems and US GAAP accounting related to Cash Flow. Familiarity with Power accounting models (CSA contracts, overtime projects, point in time) Advance Excel skills, Proficiency in Cash Planning & Tools (Workiva, VPLAN, VReporting, SmartView) Proficient oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems and Ability to collaborate across a global organization Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

jobs.title: Data Scientist 3
jobs.jd: Data Scientist 3 As our Data Scientist 3, you will handle multiple projects at once and act as an internal business consultant to help optimize every facet of this organization. You will solve problems and answer questions – using data – for other departments to help us reduce costs, reduce errors, and be a better organization for our 17 million members. Note: This is a hybrid role; the candidate must reside within a 100-mile radius of our Costa Mesa CA office and be available to work on-site 3 days a week on a regular basis, as well as 2–3 times per month for team meetings and collaboration days. What You’ll Do Will understand how the specific task fits into the bigger picture and suggest how to best accomplish it within the project framework. Will self-manage tasks and projects and complete them on time and under general supervision. Every day, you will help solve business problems presented to us by stakeholders using data. You will get a scenario or problem, such as, “We need to reduce cycle times,” and then pull, analyze, and interpret data relevant to that scenario. You will pull data from SQL databases. You will analyze and interpret data using Python, R, or other tools. You will determine patterns or trends and their statistical significance to the problem. To visualize the data, you will use Tableau. Once you have done your analysis, paired with a data engineer, you will present your findings to the stakeholder and confirm, refute or simply acknowledge a hypothesis. Your work may be implemented or may develop into something else. This role is remote, but you must be able to report to the Costa Mesa, California, office for regular collaboration days. What You’ll Need To thrive in this role, you must have a solid foundation of statistics and data analysis. You must be able to describe a project where you pulled data, analyzed it, identified trends or patterns, determined significance, and delivered insights or recommendations to the business. What was your approach? What tools did you use and why? Did you get to the root cause of the issue? Did you confirm or refute a hypothesis? You must be able to speak to your involvement and decisions at each stage. For pulling data, we use SQL so you must be proficient with this tool. To curate and analyze data, we use a variety of languages and programs: Python, R, and even Excel. You can choose whatever tool helps you best, but you must be proficient in either Python or R. Excellent communication skills and an attitude of flexibility are a must. Very often, we get into the data and some aspect takes longer than we thought, or we have to pivot and change how we approach a problem. A dashboard works better than a model, perhaps. Then you have to explain to the stakeholder or the team why you made that change or why the deliverable is taking longer than expected. It’s all about being creative in your approach and communicating that frequently and clearly to people who may be less tech or data-savvy than you. #LI-SH1 The starting pay range for this position is: $109,500.00 - $146,200.00 Additionally, for full time positions, you will be eligible to participate in our incentive program based upon the achievement of organization, team and personal performance. . Remarkable benefits: • Health coverage for medical, dental, vision • 401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension • Tuition assistance • Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs • Paid parental leave • Wellness programs • Employee discounts (membership, insurance, travel, entertainment, services and more!) When we embrace our diversity – we win. All of Us! jobs.title: Data Scientist, Finance Forecasting
jobs.jd: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an early member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by establishing robust analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities for our Finance & Accounting organization. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting our financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world. As a founding Data Scientist on Anthropic's Finance Forecasting team, you'll own revenue forecasting models that drive capacity planning and board reporting, build the backtesting and accuracy discipline that makes those forecasts trustworthy, and lead causal measurement work that tells us how much a given launch or event actually moved revenue — turning what is currently a best-guess conversation into a designed, repeatable readout. We're hiring for two seats on this team, and we expect candidates to lead with depth in either production time-series forecasting or causal inference. Both shapes are first-class; tell us in your application which one feels more like you. This is a build role on a small team. The forecast is visible inside the company, and when it's wrong, people notice. We're looking for someone who would rather have their models scored than stay vague, and who is excited to set the bar for how forecasting is done here. Key responsibilities Own a core piece of the team's modeling work — either the production revenue forecasts themselves (scoping, development, backtesting, deployment, monitoring) or the causal measurement program for launches and events Build and run backtesting and accuracy tracking for your models, and use the results to improve quality cycle over cycle Contribute to the team's broader research direction, including event-aware forecast architectures, hierarchical reconciliation, and causal designs that hold up under launch-driven step-changes Translate model output and accuracy results into clear recommendations for Finance and executive leadership Partner with the team's Analytics Engineer on feature pipelines, model deployment, and the forecast store Minimum qualifications Have substantial experience in data science, forecasting, or quantitative finance, including time owning models in production rather than only in notebooks Are deeply fluent in Python and SQL and comfortable productionizing what you build Have a strong applied statistics foundation, with depth in either production time-series methods (Prophet, ETS, ARIMA, gradient-boosted approaches, neural forecasting, hierarchical reconciliation) or causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series, event studies) Have built backtesting and accuracy-tracking discipline before and are comfortable having your models scored publicly Have presented and defended a forecast or causal estimate to executives Have a bias for action and do your best work in ambiguous, early-stage environments Preferred qualifications Experience with exogenous-regressor or event-aware forecasting approaches Familiarity with hybrid or foundation-model forecasting (TimeGPT-class systems) Background in pricing and elasticity modeling or marketing-mix modeling Experience forecasting a consumption-based or usage-billed business (cloud, API, marketplace) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 — $345,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. New sellers are a critical part of Amazon's ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the earth's largest selection and lowest prices, and helping them successfully register, onboard, and scale is fundamental to that mission. The ideal candidate thrives in working in large and complex data warehouse environments, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, is motivated by developing innovative and simplified solutions to solve complex analytical problems and is passionate about working with large data sets and bringing data together to answer business questions and drive change. jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.jd: King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape. The Treasury Analyst supports the firm’s global treasury operations by managing daily liquidity, cash reporting and forecasting, payment execution, bank account administration, and treasury controls. The role analyzes treasury data, supports banking and financial risk activities, and partners with Finance and other business teams to improve processes, strengthen controls, and provide timely, accurate information for decision-making. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Prepare daily cash positions, monitor liquidity across domestic and international accounts, and communicate cash balances and material activity to leadership. Prepare and execute electronic payments and cash transfers through approved banking platforms in accordance with authorization requirements and segregation-of-duties controls. Prepare short- and medium-term cash forecasts, analyze forecast-to-actual variances, and recommend improvements to forecast accuracy. Monitor excess operating cash and execute approved transfers or investment transactions consistent with firm policy. Support day-to-day relationships with domestic and global banking partners, coordinate service requests, and assist with bank fee and service reviews. Administer bank accounts and related documentation, including account openings and closings, authorized signatories, user access, and periodic access reviews. Administer the firm’s credit card programs and respond to internal and external inquiries. Prepare debt covenant calculations, compliance certificates, and related quarterly and annual reporting in accordance with credit agreements. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN. Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements , translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting. Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting. Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. Preferred / Bonus Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data). Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. 

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.



Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.



Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 



What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Business Insights Analyst- Branch Network Distribution
jobs.jd: Position Overview Citizens Bank is executing a multi-year transformation of its retail branch network, shifting toward a performance-driven, growth-oriented distribution model and investing in branch reformats, refreshes, closures, de novos, staffing models, and operating-hour changes. The Business Analyst, Branch Network Distribution will support the reporting, analytics, experimentation, and impact measurement used to understand network performance and evaluate whether branch actions are delivering their intended outcomes. The analyst will work with more experienced team members to prepare data, build recurring reporting, conduct structured analyses, and translate findings into clear business insights. This is a hands-on developmental role for an early-career analyst who is eager to build technical, analytical, and business skills while supporting visible priorities across Distribution Transformation, Retail Banking, Marketing, Finance, and the Consumer Bank. Key Responsibilities Network Performance Reporting & Insights Support the development and maintenance of reporting and dashboards that measure branch network performance using leading and lagging indicators. Prepare performance views across banker, branch, market, and enterprise levels to support day-to-day management and longer-term decisions. Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities and summarize findings for review by senior team members and business partners. Branch Action Analytics & Impact Measurement Support analyses that measure the results of branch network actions, including reformats, refreshes, closures, de novos, staffing changes, and changes to operating hours. Assess outcomes across customer behavior, productivity, financial performance, and growth using established analytical approaches. Help account for factors such as market conditions, seasonality, and overlapping initiatives, with guidance from experienced analysts. Experimentation & Test-and-Learn Support Assist in developing pilots and tests with clear objectives, success measures, comparison groups, and evaluation plans. Prepare analyses that help determine whether an initiative should be expanded, refined, or discontinued. Document methods, assumptions, and results so conclusions are transparent and repeatable. Physical Network Marketing Value Analysis Support analysis of the branch network as a customer acquisition, relationship-deepening, and brand asset. Help assess how branch presence, format, and investment relate to customer behavior across channels and over time. Partner with Marketing, Finance, and Distribution colleagues to incorporate relevant data into growth and investment analyses. Data Preparation & Analytical Execution Build working knowledge of branch, banker productivity, customer, marketing, and financial data. Use SQL and tools such as Alteryx, or equivalent tools, to source, cleanse, join, and prepare analytical datasets. Complete quality checks and help maintain consistent metrics, definitions, assumptions, and documentation across analyses and reporting. Business Intelligence & Tool Support Build and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using established data models and team standards. Help improve the automation, performance, usability, and documentation of reporting assets. Learn and apply business intelligence, visualization, and emerging analytical tools to improve productivity while following applicable governance requirements. Business Partnering & Communication Work with team members and business partners to clarify questions, gather requirements, and translate business needs into structured analysis. Prepare clear presentations, summaries, and supporting materials that explain findings, implications, and limitations. Respond thoughtfully to feedback and refine analyses and reporting based on stakeholder needs. Project Support & Continuous Improvement Manage assigned work, meet agreed timelines, and provide clear updates on progress, questions, and risks. Contribute to team projects by completing defined analytical workstreams with guidance and review. Identify practical opportunities to improve data quality, repeatability, speed, and clarity. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. 0-3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, finance, strategy, or a related role; relevant internships, academic projects, or co-op experience may be considered. Foundational SQL skills and experience working with structured data; exposure to Alteryx or a similar data preparation tool is helpful. Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform through work, internships, or academic projects. Working knowledge of analytical methods, including trend analysis, performance measurement, and basic test or comparison design. Ability to organize data, check work carefully, and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner. Interest in financial services, retail banking, customer analytics, or physical distribution is helpful but not required. Leadership & Soft Skills Analytically curious - asks thoughtful questions, looks for patterns, and is eager to understand what the data means Detail-oriented - produces accurate work and checks data, assumptions, and outputs carefully. Clear communicator - explains analysis in straightforward language and adapts based on feedback. Collaborative - works effectively with teammates and business partners and contributes positively to team outcomes. Organized and accountable - manages assigned work, follows through on commitments, and raises questions early. Growth-oriented - seeks feedback, develops new technical and business skills, and applies lessons to future work. jobs.jd: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Data Scientist II Expedia Group is looking for a Data Scientist II to help improve the post-booking experience for travelers. You will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical methods to answer product and service questions, understand performance, and help teams make evidence-based decisions. Working with experienced data scientists and cross-functional partners, you will take analytical work from a clearly framed question through findings and recommendations. In this role you will: Analyze traveler servicing and service-platform data to identify trends, explain performance changes, and uncover opportunities to improve experiences and operations. Build and maintain analyses, dashboards, and recurring metrics that help partners understand service health and outcomes. Support the design and evaluation of experiments, including metric selection, data validation, interpretation, and clear communication of results. Apply statistical techniques and exploratory analysis to investigate product questions and assess the likely impact of proposed changes. Use SQL and a programming language such as Python or R to work with data, automate repeatable analyses, and document your methods. Partner with product, engineering, operations, and analytics teammates to clarify questions, share findings, and help translate insights into next steps. Present analytical results in a clear, concise way, explaining assumptions, limitations, and implications for non-technical audiences. Contribute to reliable analytical practices, including data quality checks, reproducible work, and consistent metric definitions. Experience and Qualifications: Experience applying analytics, data science, statistics, or a related discipline to business or product questions. Working proficiency in SQL and Python, R, or a similar analytical programming language. Foundational knowledge of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design. Experience exploring datasets, validating results, and communicating findings with charts, dashboards, or written narratives. jobs.title: Consultant -- Azure, Data & AI
jobs.jd: Coretek is seeking an Azure Data & AI Consultant to design, implement, and optimize modern data and AI solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. In this role, you will partner closely with clients to modernize data platforms, enable advanced analytics, and deliver AI-driven insights that support business transformation. You will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines, integrating AI services, and ensuring solutions align with industry best practices. This role requires strong technical expertise in Azure data services, experience with AI integration, and the ability to work effectively in a client-facing consulting environment. Key Responsibilities Client Engagement: Act as a trusted advisor by conducting workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting solutions to both technical and business audiences. Data Platform Development: Design and implement Azure-based data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Azure database systems (SQL, Cosmos DB, Postgres). Data Engineering: Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate large volumes of structured and unstructured data from diverse sources. AI Integration: Leverage Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Cognitive Services to deliver intelligent business solutions. Solution Architecture Support: Collaborate with architects to design scalable, secure, and high-performance Azure Data & AI architectures. DevOps & Automation: Implement version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code tools (Bicep, Terraform). Data Governance & Security: Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security requirements including RBAC, encryption, and identity management. Analytics & Visualization: Develop advanced reporting and interactive dashboards with Power BI to deliver actionable insights to stakeholders. Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior team members, contribute to internal best practices, and stay current with Azure Data & AI innovations. 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or AI, with hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure. Strong proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python for data processing and AI tasks. Hands-on experience with at least two Azure data services such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Azure SQL, or Cosmos DB. Familiarity with AI services in Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, and Cognitive Services. Experience developing Power BI solutions for advanced analytics and data storytelling. Understanding of modern data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time streaming solutions. Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and security best practices. Strong communication and presentation skills for client-facing engagements. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. Preferred: Experience with event-driven architectures using Azure Event Hub, Service Bus, or Kafka. Familiarity with distributed computing and performance optimization in Databricks/Spark environments. Experience with consulting or client-facing project delivery. Exposure to ML Ops practices and operationalizing machine learning models. Azure certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900). Why Join Coretek? Microsoft Azure Expert Partner: Contribute to cutting-edge Azure Data & AI projects with access to Microsoft's latest innovations and technical resources. Career Growth: Advance your expertise through certifications, hands-on learning, and mentorship opportunities. Collaborative Culture: Work alongside top-tier architects and consultants in a supportive, client-first environment. Professional Development: Access to training resources, Azure learning paths, and opportunities to work on diverse client engagements

jobs.title: PGIM - Investment Analyst, Portfolio Analysis Group
jobs.jd: Job Classification: Investment Management - Investments A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What you will do The Portfolio Analysis Group (PAG) partners closely with investment teams to provide the analytics and insights that support portfolio construction, risk monitoring, performance analysis, and investment decision-making. Our PAG Analyst Program is a three-year rotational program designed to provide broad exposure across asset classes, investment strategies, and portfolio management teams. Analysts complete one-year rotations across PAG and select partner teams, developing a strong foundation in portfolio analytics while gaining firsthand experience across the investment process. Core rotations may include General Account, Investment Grade, High Yield, Emerging Markets, US/Global Rates & Hedge Fund, Structured Products, and Multi-Sector. Satellite rotations may include CLO Structuring, Structured Products Research, and Investment Risk Management. This incoming Analyst will begin the program aligned to our Structured Products / Asset-Based Finance (ABF) team , where they will work closely with Portfolio Managers and other investment partners to analyze portfolio positioning and performance, monitor risk and client objectives, and deliver actionable insights that support day-to-day portfolio management. This position follows a hybrid work model, with working 3 days in the Newark, NJ office and 2 days remote. What you can expect Analyze portfolio positioning relative to benchmarks, client objectives, risk parameters, and investment goals, identifying changes in exposures and opportunities to improve portfolio alignment. Produce portfolio analytics and performance attribution to help explain investment results and inform portfolio management decisions. Incorporate client guidelines, investment objectives, and risk tolerances into portfolio monitoring, scenario analysis, and portfolio management workflows. Partner with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Risk Managers, Quantitative teams, Credit Research, Client Advisory, technology partners, and senior PAG team members. Support timely market, portfolio, and client analyses while improving recurring reports, analytical tools, and repeatable processes. What you will bring Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of relevant experience in investment management, financial services, portfolio or risk analytics, research, or a related analytical field. Proficiency with Excel and familiarity with investment and data analytics tools such as Bloomberg, Aladdin, SQL, and Python preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, actionable insights. A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across investment, risk, research, and technology teams. What will set you apart Strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to problem solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced investment environment. Exposure to coding best practices, including documentation, version control, testing, peer review, and writing maintainable code. Pursuit of the CFA designation or an MBA is a plu s. *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. Note : Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $90,000 to $100,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits. Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. #LI-SC1 #LI-Hybrid What we offer you: Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level. Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave. 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%). Company-funded pension plan. Wellness Programs including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs. Work/Life Resources to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matters, education, emotional and mental health, and career development. Education Benefit to help finance traditional college enrollment toward obtaining an approved degree and many accredited certificate programs. Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Shares can be purchased at 85% of the lower of two prices (Beginning or End of the purchase period). Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. To find out more about our Total Rewards package, visit Work Life Balance | Prudential Careers. Some of the above benefits may not apply to part-time employees scheduled to work less than 20 hours per week. Prudential Financial, Inc. of the United States is not affiliated with Prudential plc. which is headquartered in the United Kingdom. Prudential is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability, marital status, age, veteran status, domestic partner status, medical condition or any other characteristic protected by law. To maintain the integrity and security of our hiring process, Prudential may use identity verification technologies. Your consent will be obtained before any verification takes place. If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email accommodations.hw@prudential.com . If you are experiencing a technical issue with your application or an assessment, please email careers.technicalsupport@prudential.com to request assistance.

jobs.title: Treasury Digital Assets Analyst
jobs.jd: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Join Visa Treasury's Digital Assets and Innovation team to help reshape how money moves with digital assets like stablecoins and next-gen payment rails. In this role, you'll own operations end to end, develop treasury roadmaps, and guide decisions, partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Settlement Ops, Finance, and Product to vet ideas and design and launch pilots with external partners. You'll keep a close pulse on the crypto ecosystem and turn research into clear recommendations. We're looking for someone who brings big ideas and takes ownership, yet stays grounded in treasury fundamentals like liquidity, settlement, reconciliation, and controls. This role is perfect if you're ready to roll up your sleeves, move fast, and help define the next chapter of money movement at Visa. Key Responsibilities: Run daily treasury operations across digital assets and traditional payments, including cash, liquidity, settlement, and reconciliation. Execute treasury activities across blockchains, custodians, wallets, banks, exchanges, and payment providers. Participate in a rotating weekend and after-hours support model for critical treasury operations and incident response. Monitor fiat and digital asset liquidity, funding needs, and operational risk controls. Support stablecoin operations, including minting, redemption, custody transfers, wallet funding, and exception management. Own settlement, reconciliation, operational controls, audit readiness, and issue resolution processes. Improve runbooks, procedures, controls, and escalation frameworks. Track KPIs and operational metrics; provide actionable insights to leadership. Assess opportunities and risks across digital asset use cases, focusing on liquidity, efficiency, settlement, and working capital impacts. Monitor developments across blockchain, stablecoin, custody, payments, and regulatory ecosystems. Create executive-ready presentations, strategy memos, and business recommendations. Lead pilot execution from planning through launch, including governance, testing, vendor diligence, and operational readiness. Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions. Support selection and evaluation of custody, wallet, banking, payment, and blockchain infrastructure providers. This role is a Hybrid position to be located in our Foster City, CA office location. This role requires weekend operations. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD) Preferred Qualifications: 3 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) Experience in treasury, payments, fintech, consulting, strategy, or operations with cross-functional project delivery. Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Treasury fundamentals: liquidity, cash management, settlement, reconciliation, FX, and working capital. Digital assets: stablecoins, custody, wallets, blockchain networks, transaction fees, and ecosystem participants. Payments: ACH, SWIFT, RTP, FedNow, SEPA Instant, card settlement, and cross-border payments. Incident management, root-cause analysis, and process improvement. Data analysis and reporting using Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Operational controls, governance, audit readiness, and documentation. Executive communication and stakeholder management. Strong project management and cross-functional leadership. High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to balance strategy with execution. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $104,900.00 to $ 163,000.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.jd: Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble! Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country. Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference! O.N.E Purpose: Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations. Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation. Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results. The Opportunity: Position Overview The Analytics Engineer plays a critical role in transforming curated data into clear, consistent, and analytics ready ‑ data models that power reporting, dashboards, and decision-making ‑ across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and the business—owning the semantic layer, partnering closely with stakeholders, and ensuring that metrics are trusted, well-defined ‑ , and easy to use. The ideal candidate is deeply skilled in SQL based transformations and dimensional modeling, has strong business acumen, and is passionate about enabling analysts and leaders with high-quality, intuitive data. Essential Job Functions Design, build, and maintain analytics ready ‑ data models, including facts, dimensions, and data marts. Develop and manage transformations primarily in the semantic and transformation layer using SQL based tooling Define and maintain metrics, business logic, and calculations to ensure consistency across dashboards, reports, and analyses. Apply dimensional modeling best practices optimized for BI and analytical consumption. Partner closely with product, operations, finance, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into well-defined ‑ data models and metrics. Act as a steward of business logic—ensuring definitions are clear, documented, and aligned across teams. Proactively identify gaps, ambiguities, or inconsistencies in metrics and drive alignment toward standardized definitions. Optimize data models for clarity, usability, and performance for downstream consumers, including analysts and self-service ‑ BI users. Support analysts and BI developers by enabling faster, more reliable dashboard and report development. Ensure analytics outputs are intuitive, discoverable, and trusted by decision ‑ makers. Implement data quality checks and testing at the analytics layer to ensure accuracy and reliability. Contribute to analytics engineering standards, conventions, and documentation. Collaborate with data engineering partners to provide feedback on source data structure and readiness for analytics. Qualifications Required Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, analytics, business intelligence, or a related role. Advanced SQL expertise, with a strong track record of building complex, maintainable transformations. Hands ‑ on dbt experience Product or application engineering experience is a plus, with an understanding of both data and how it’s used in product and engineering applications. Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, metrics design, and semantic layer concepts. Experience supporting BI tools and downstream analytics use cases (dashboards, reporting, ad hoc analysis). Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Experience in healthcare-related operations, with an understanding of industry processes and terminology. This position pays between $84,000 - $126,000 based on experience Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement. jobs.title: Pricing Analyst
jobs.jd: WHO WE ARE We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry. Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together. WHAT WE’LL NEED The Pricing Analyst will support Wingstop’s Menu & Pricing vertical in developing, executing, and measuring menu-pricing, promotional, and value strategies. This role will turn pricing strategy into clear, market-relevant recommendations and disciplined execution that franchisees can understand and stand behind. Working closely with Pricing, Menu Strategy, Marketing, Digital, Technology, Finance, Operations, and Franchise Business Management, the Pricing Analyst will provide the analytics, testing, execution coordination, and performance tracking that enable the Menu & Pricing team to make better decisions and implement them consistently. Core Responsibilities Pricing, Promotion & Menu Analytics Support the development of pricing strategy, price guardrails, and governance through analysis of pricing, transactions, check, mix, cost, margin, guest behavior, and market conditions. Conduct competitive price-gap and value-positioning analysis across relevant competitors. Analyze pricing performance across markets and locations to identify opportunities and risks related to guest behavior, revenue, profitability, and value perception. Support pricing recommendations for menu, promotional, and other commercial initiatives. Support the development and refinement of pricing architecture, menu strategy, value propositions, and promotional guardrails. Monitor pricing effectiveness and consistency across markets; identify opportunities to strengthen governance while allowing appropriate local flexibility. Build clear, decision-ready analyses and materials for Pricing leadership, senior management, and franchisee-facing conversations. Test, Learn & Measure Support the design and execution of tests for pricing, value propositions, menu strategy, bundles, and promotions. Define measurement plans and success criteria in partnership with the Menu & Pricing team. Analyze test results and translate findings into recommendations to scale, refine, or discontinue initiatives. Monitor the impact of pricing actions and surface insights, risks, and recommended actions in a timely manner. Franchisee Engagement & Pricing Execution Support franchisee engagement and change management throughout pricing rounds, including intake discussions, recommendation reviews, follow-up, and adoption tracking. Monitor pricing requests and exceptions, escalating decisions as appropriate and helping maintain approved price architecture and governance. Coordinate execution of approved pricing and promotional changes across relevant systems and consumer touchpoints. Partner with cross-functional teams to document requirements, support testing, confirm changes are implemented accurately, and resolve data or execution issues. Support the Menu & Pricing team’s relationship with the revenue management system provider, including data validation, issue tracking, and performance monitoring. Maintain clear documentation of pricing recommendations, test results, exceptions, execution status, and key assumptions. Success Measures Success in this role will be measured by: Quality, timeliness, and business relevance of pricing, promotion, and value analyses. Accuracy and on-time execution of approved price and promotional changes. Quality and usefulness of pricing reporting, dashboards, and test readouts. Strength and timeliness of competitive pricing and market-value intelligence. Effective cross-functional coordination across Pricing, Menu Strategy, Marketing, Digital, Technology, Finance, Operations, and franchisee partners. WHAT YOU’LL NEED Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in pricing, revenue growth management, analytics, finance, strategy, consulting, or a related commercial role. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets; SQL and Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, Python, or R experience preferred. Strong analytical and financial-modeling capabilities, including comfort with pricing, elasticity, forecasting, and profitability analysis. Ability to translate complex analyses into concise, practical recommendations and clear stories for a range of audiences. Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and project-management skills. High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and time-sensitive execution work. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach. Experience in restaurants, retail, consumer products, foodservice, or a franchised business is preferred. Prior exposure to franchisee or operator conversations and pricing platforms is a plus, but not required. WHO YOU ARE No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can. You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward. You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward. You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst II – Model Ready Data Team
jobs.jd: Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose. Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation. Position Summary The Model Ready Data Team builds the modeling data service behind EnCompass, Yes Energy’s power system simulation engine. We produce and maintain the model-ready datasets for North American power systems (generators, load, fuels, transmission, emissions, reserves, and more) that form the baseline for customers’ modeling ecosystems, along with the assumptions documentation that explains every input. We bridge Yes Energy’s Data Platform and Modeling disciplines by translating power system data and historical reports into modeling inputs and supporting the development of proprietary nodal LMP forecasts. As a Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst you will build, validate, and automate those datasets while developing expertise in one or more power markets. Position Details Salary Range: $105,000-$115,000 Location: Hybrid – Boulder, CO; Seattle, WA; or Boston (Newton), MA Full-time Reporting to: Director, Model Ready Data Travel requirements: Occasional travel as needed for client or team collaboration Primary Responsibilities Data Model Development: Build, test, and analyze data models for North American power systems, delivered as model-ready datasets for EnCompass Model Updates: Run regular model-update cycles: refresh generation fleets, load forecasts, fuel prices, interchanges, emissions, reserves, and transmission constraints from internal, public, and commercial sources Technical Optimization: Develop and maintain Python-based automation that ensures data quality from source to product Validation & Benchmarking: Validate models by running simulations, benchmarking results against historical market outcomes, and diagnosing discrepancies Automation : Automate recurring analytics & modeling workflows to increase operational efficiency across departments Documentation: Maintain customer-facing assumptions documentation for each market/region we model Market & Client Expertise: Become an expert in one or more power markets; support clients with case diagnosis and expert advice on power market modeling Continuous Improvement: Identify and research new data sources, tools, and modeling structures to improve model quality and sophistication Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a similar quantitative field Understanding of North American power market fundamentals and energy economics Strong technical execution and proven experience using Python (or similar) for data manipulation and automation Comfort working with large, messy tabular data (CSV, Excel, SQL) and checking it against its source A knack for good software and the habits that produce it: version control, code review, testing, and readable code Excellent analytical skills in response to open-ended questions Ability to work efficiently on multiple, non-overlapping tasks with minimal supervision Confidence in presenting technical content to both colleagues and clients Passion for the energy transition Preferred Qualifications Advanced Degree: M.S. or Ph.D. in engineering or computer science with a focus on power systems Simulation Experience: Experience with power system models such as Enelytix, EnCompass, PLEXOS, AURORA, or PROMOD; optimization, production cost modeling, or capacity expansion modeling experience Software Engineering: Practical experience contributing to large code bases Data Platforms: Experience with workflow orchestration (Dagster, Airflow, or similar) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, AWS) Renewables Modeling: Experience with geospatial or weather data, or wind/solar generation modeling Systems Thinking: Ability to view the grid holistically, understanding dependencies between technology, data, and market processes. ABOUT YES ENERGY Overview Yes Energy delivers real-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Since its inception in 2008, Yes Energy has become a trusted and respected supplier of innovative and reliable solutions focused on the needs of power market analysts, traders, and trade managers. Yes Energy has a team of 400 amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand; and Bucharest, Romania. Culture Yes Energy has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Colorado, and we have the culture to prove it. At Yes Energy, we care about saying “Yes” to customers. We like to listen, learn, and develop our solutions in line with their needs. We think about customers as business partners, and when we help them be more successful … we are more successful, too. Around the office, our culture is driven by some pretty fundamental values that we’re proud of: We love innovation and solving tough challenges; We are “high standards people” who combine passion and pride with hard work and rewards of all kinds-- in an ethic that is consistent across the company. We’re team-focused with a flat hierarchy-- we work in small teams on well-defined projects that directly impact the success of the business; We play to the strengths and experience of each person while each of us also works along a continuum of roles adjacent to our focus area. This presents the challenge of maintaining a broad set of skills as well as an opportunity to learn and contribute in many ways. We are constantly growing. Professional development happens every day and every year. Compensation and Benefits We offer highly competitive salaries and real bonuses that are achievable and that you can impact. Our benefits package is also very competitive, including medical insurance, a 401 (k) Plan with matching, flexible vacation, and flexible work schedules. Yes Energy encourages and funds investment in both formal and informal professional development. At Yes Energy, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. In accordance with Colorado law, the range provided is Yes Energy’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. jobs.title: Analyst, Banking Operations (Domestic)
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.jd: Why join us Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Operations at Brex Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong. What you’ll do Brex is building the operating system for growing companies, and reliable funds movement is at the core. As a Banking Operations Analyst on our Domestic Payments team, you will work the US payment rails (ACH,checks, domestic wires, stablecoin) and investigate returns and exceptions, and keep our customers’ money moving accurately and on time. You’ll combine precision and rigor in controls with cross-functional collaboration to keep customers’ funds safe, timely, and accounted for. If you meet most, but not all, of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Where you’ll work This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work! Responsibilities Work the domestic payments queue across ACH, checks, domestic wires and stablecoin, resolving cases in Salesforce with clear, customer-safe explanations. Monitor ACH and wire returns, interpreting return codes and running the right procedure for each. Watch for trends before they become incidents and escalate with clear context and urgency. Work exceptions with external banking partners, bringing the right identifiers and evidence to speed resolution. Keep the queue healthy by maintaining Salesforce routing and hygiene, balancing case quality and attention to detail. Write and maintain documentation (SOPs, training materials) and help onboard and cross-train new analysts. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.jd:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

 - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

 - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

 - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

 - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest.

 - Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.

Qualifications

 - Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads.

 - Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business.

 - Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.
